param_input_item.param_description: vectors listing the dimensions of A and B to contract. size(A, dimA(k)) must equal size(B, dimB(k)).
number of dimensions of A, used to account for trailing singleton dimensions.

param_output_item.param_description: tensor product. Its dimensions are the uncontracted dimensions of A followed by the uncontracted dimensions of B.

description.p: tensorprod(A, B) returns the outer product of A and B, an array of size [size(A) size(B)].
tensorprod(A, B, dimA, dimB) contracts (sums the products over) the dimensions dimA of A with the dimensions dimB of B. For matrices, tensorprod(A, B, 2, 1) is the matrix product A*B.
tensorprod(A, B, 'all') contracts every dimension and returns the full inner product; A and B must have the same size.
'NumDimensionsA' specifies how many dimensions A has so that trailing singleton dimensions can be contracted.
